consumer: The offline map-dump writer (write_tiles) recording each tile's authoritative terrain id; it asks 'what terrain occupies this tile in the world?', not a yes/no nor what the GUI shows.
scope: a map region (every nearby tile within the export window/radius)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles reads ctx.m.ter(p).id().str(), pulling the raw terrain string id straight off the map for each tile rather than any computed predicate or display-filtered view.
divergence: A tile whose underlying terrain was transformed (e.g. floor turned to a pit) but the player's remembered/displayed glyph is stale: a display-proxy (D) answer would emit the remembered 't_floor' while raw state holds 't_pit_covered' — exposing a wrong, non-ground-truth answer.
